reference_implementation_a.sql: SELECT t.team_id,COUNT(DISTINCT s.employee_id) AS june_workers FROM teams t LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.team_id=t.team_id LEFT JOIN shifts s ON s.employee_id=e.employee_id AND s.starts_at>=TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-06-01' AND s.starts_at<TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-07-01' GROUP BY t.team_id ORDER BY t.team_id
